title: Harder Armours
description: Makes netherite progression more difficult and adds padding for armours
body:
Dependencies
Sheepish's API
This is my first mod so please leave suggestions and recommendations as i would love to implement more into my mod! # Harder Armours - All Armour types now require their leather variants inside one of the free slots in order to craft - (can be changed in the config if you just want the Harder Netherite instead of both) ![Helmet Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8ccc441c52628def1211b20a3be36ad9c2a9cf0.png) # **Harder Netherite** - Netherite Armour and Tools now require Enriched Netherite Ingots with the Smithing Template to forge - (can be changed in the config if you just want the Harder Armours instead of both) ![Items the Mod adds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff67d087c34db720d6a442919f2c7d55880f6538.png) - In order to get Enriched Netherite Ingots you must now put "Clump of Netherite Scrap"(Renamed Netherite Ingots) into a Blast Furnace to get "Raw Netherite" which is then used in the crafting for Enriched Netherite Ingots ## Enriched Netherite - Enriched Netherite also comes in a Block for which can be used for beacons if you so wished (I dont actually know why you would want to) ### Enriched Netherite Ingot Recipe ![Enriched Netherite Ingot Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9bf69626e73194a2bc55f2d3af76d09d7e719f4.png) ### Enriched Netherite Block ![Enriched Netherite Block Beacon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f0b2f9b13edbd6adb32835b5bcb7ce54ee81daa.png) - It can also be used for the payment item (at the moment i dont know how to add it to the gui) ![Beacon Payment Item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5096c81941dbf381bbbef1145ea6dbd55af52675.png) ### Netherite Scrap Block - added a new Netherite Scrap Block to Harder Netherite which can be used as a Beacon Base (not beacon payment item) ![Netherite Scrap Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/395d91b7af4b8b11e3733154c9ddc82d7cc5b437.png) # Trimmed Netherite - Added a new Cracked Trim Armour set which can be toggled in the config - The only way to get this item is to have the config enabled and it automatically applies when you craft the Netherite Armour (I can add a working Smithing Template to this if requested) ![Trimmed Netherite](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e90f54815e859004757730243a4264cdd321819.png)
